findings.description: Long-lived AWS access key and secret key are embedded in plaintext in the Lambda environment variables (access_key = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE", secret_key = "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY"). Anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration or read access to the Terraform state can retrieve them, and the credentials cannot be rotated without a redeploy.
The function uses runtime "nodejs12.x", which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving the function dependent on an unpatched Node.js release (CWE-1104).
